For any non-empty recipient array and any call that does not revert internally, C.transfer always returns true; transfer never propagates a revert and always succeeds when at least one recipient is provided.
When caddress has no code, every low-level call in transfer silently succeeds (returns true), so transfer never reverts and always returns true for any non-empty recipient array.
